name: May this competitor submit?
description: The refusal, on load, so /submit reads as an explanation rather than a door that is shut. The verdict is the one soma-submissions-create computes, in the same words, so the page cannot say one thing before the POST and another after it. THREE OF THE FOUR REFUSALS ARE KNOWABLE HERE; the fourth is not, because weights_already_entered depends on a hash the competitor has not typed yet. Like soma-models-list, live_sessions is the outer FROM: a NULL body is an unknown game and a 404, no row at all is a dead session and a 401, and the two must not be confused.

input.query: WITH ctx AS ( SELECT g.slug, s.id AS season_id, s.number, s.submissions_open_at, s.submissions_close_at, CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN season_state(s) END AS state, (s.id IS NOT NULL AND now() >= s.submissions_open_at AND now() < s.submissions_close_at) AS season_open, (s.id IS NOT NULL AND season_admits(s, ($2)::uuid)) AS participant, (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', m.id, 'version', m.version, 'phase', model_phase(m)) FROM models m WHERE m.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND m.game_id = g.id AND m.status IN ('testing', 'verified')) AS in_flight, (SELECT coalesce(max(m.version), 0) + 1 FROM models m WHERE m.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND m.game_id = g.id) AS next_version FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text ) SELECT ls.sid AS session_ok, (SELECT json_build_object( 'game', ctx.slug, 'season', CASE WHEN ctx.season_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE json_build_object( 'number', ctx.number, 'state', ctx.state, 'submissions_open_at', ctx.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', ctx.submissions_close_at) END, 'participant', ctx.participant, 'next_version', ctx.next_version, 'in_flight', ctx.in_flight, 'refusal', CASE WHEN NOT ctx.season_open THEN 'season_not_open' WHEN NOT ctx.participant THEN 'not_a_participant' WHEN ctx.in_flight IS NOT NULL THEN 'version_in_flight' END) FROM ctx) AS body FROM live_sessions ls WHERE ls.sid = ($3)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($2)::uuid
